2608.27428.title: Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models
2608.27428.paper_summary: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. We show that applying this correction recursively gives an unbiased estimator of the target prefix probability and lets us estimate the mass lost by threshold pruning. Our beam-summing algorithm extends the retained source prefixes and samples which prefixes to keep, reducing their number as more probability mass is added to the running estimate. This can save computation and guarantees that the run halts with probability one. We evaluate the method on encyclopedic text and DNA against sequential Monte Carlo baselines that resample with replacement. It achieves a better compute--variance tradeoff on text and lower error at the same maximum number of particles on DNA. On a DNA-to-amino-acid transduction, it reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude relative to threshold-pruned beam summing and makes estimating prefix probabilities for long target strings feasible. Replacing threshold pruning with unbiased sampling in a published reading-time analysis substantially lowers the estimated corpus surprisal but leaves the published conclusions unchanged.
2608.27428.paper_summary_zh: 轉導語言模型（TLMs）將一個預訓練的 \emph{源} 語言模型與一個功能性有限狀態轉導器結合，以在 \emph{目標} 字串上誘導一個語言模型。計算在 TLM 下目標前綴的概率相當於對所有源字串的源模型概率進行求和，這些源字串被轉導器映射到以該前綴開頭的目標字串。這個集合可能是指數級大或無限。先前的工作使用基於源前綴概率的計算捷徑，然後用閾值修剪的束求和來近似結果的總和。這產生了一個未知誤差的下限。相反，我們在不替換的情況下重新抽樣源前綴，並根據其包含概率的倒數重新加權每個選定的前綴。我們顯示，遞歸地應用這個修正可以得到目標前綴概率的無偏估計量，並讓我們估計由閾值修剪所損失的質量。我們的束求和算法擴展了保留的源前綴並抽樣要保留的前綴，隨著更多概率質量被添加到運行估計中，減少它們的數量。這可以節省計算並保證運行以概率一停止。我們在百科全書文本和 DNA 上評估該方法，與使用替換的序列蒙特卡羅基準相比。它在文本上實現了更好的計算-方差權衡，在 DNA 上則在相同的最大粒子數下達到更低的誤差。在 DNA 到氨基酸的轉導中，相對於閾值修剪的束求和，它將運行時間減少了幾個數量級，並使得長目標字串的前綴概率估計變得可行。在已發表的閱讀時間分析中，用無偏抽樣替換閾值修剪大幅降低了估計的語料庫驚訝度，但未改變已發表的結論。
